comply-in.span: Combines text, images, and audio for richer context understanding.
Processes multiple data types in a single model architecture.
Finds relevant content across different modalities at query time.
Update with new data types without full model retraining.

p: Multimodal AI is an artificial intelligence system that processes and integrates multiple types of data—such as text, images, and audio—simultaneously within a unified architecture, enabling it to understand, reason, and generate responses that leverage the combined context of different modalities, leading to more human-like comprehension and more accurate, grounded outputs without requiring separate models per data type.

sec-head.p: The same five-step pipeline animating in the signature panel above, applied to your own multimodal data.

card.p: A user submits a query that may include text, an image, or an audio clip.
Each modality is converted into a numerical embedding capturing its meaning.
The system finds the most relevant chunks across all modalities in a vector database.
Retrieved content from all modalities joins the query in the model's context window.
The model generates a response that can include text, images, or audio with sources.
